name: MENYO-20k — English↔Yorùbá multi-domain (test)
description: MENYO-20k — the held-out multi-domain English↔Yorùbá test split (6,633 sentences with verified diacritics): news (47%), TED talk transcripts (30%), book + proverbs (19%), software/digital strings (4%) — proportions measured from the per-domain test files at the pinned commit, which partition the combined split exactly. Both directions scored. Fetched on demand from the pinned commit; Champollion never hosts the content. Contamination HIGH — public since 2021, in frontier-model crawls, AND the MAFAND-MT yor test set derives from a MENYO-20k re-split (cross-contamination: the two are not independent evidence). License CC BY-NC 4.0 (verified at the pin) → non-commercial lanes only; cleared by the license review of 2026-08-24 into the NC research lane: benchmarkable; never in a commercial, prize, or API lane; remote evaluation only over no-train channels.

segments.name: MENYO-20k test
segments.purpose: MT evaluation — held-out benchmark test split (relative-comparison-only)

download.instructions: Single file data/test.tsv fetched from the pinned commit (immutable); pairing.mode tsv-columns pairs the English and Yoruba columns of the same row. Both directions are scored.

source.citation: Adelani et al. (2021). The Effect of Domain and Diacritics in Yoruba–English Neural Machine Translation. MT Summit 2021.

license.notes: Verified at the pinned commit: the repo LICENSE is CC BY-NC 4.0. NC → non-commercial lanes only (license_use.py commercial lane is STRICT). Champollion never hosts the content.

usageRestrictions.communityNotes: Held-out benchmark: training on it defeats its purpose. CC BY-NC 4.0 → kept out of every commercial / prize / API lane. Content is fetched from source, never hosted.

contamination.reasoning: MENYO-20k test set — public since 2021 and in frontier-model training crawls; additionally the MAFAND-MT yor test set derives from a MENYO-20k re-split (per the lafand-mt README), so MENYO-20k and MAFAND yor scores are cross-contaminated and must never be read as independent evidence for the same system. Scores are valid only for relative method-vs-method comparison on this exact corpus. Forced HIGH here and via build_registry.HELD_OUT_BENCHMARK_FAMILIES.

licenseReview.basis: CC BY-NC 4.0, stated and verified at the pinned revision. Plain standard SPDX non-commercial license: benchmarkable; excluded from every commercial, prize, and API lane; remote evaluation only over channels that do not train on inputs (transmission_policy no-train lane). The measured cross-contamination with the MAFAND yor test set stays recorded on the card; scores across the two are never treated as independent evidence.
